body.untyped.evidence: Run against the fake: the body goes only through -MessageFile, no argument holds any line of it (test-wezfleet-messenger.ps1), and no typed text holds any line of it (test-messenger-conformance.ps1, 2026-10-06). Run against wezfleet main 1122461 in an isolated root with no terminal reachable (2026-10-09): the stored record's body equalled the sent two-line, non-ASCII body, and main's own Stop hook handed it over as its block text. Read, not run: the only text main types into a pane is its one-line wake notice (lib/MailPost.ps1, Invoke-WfMailWake).

idempotent.post.evidence: Run against wezfleet main 1122461 in an isolated root (2026-10-09): a repost of an id answered already-posted with the first copy's stage, before and after the receiver took it, and one record of the id was on disk. Run against the fake: one record, no new wake and the later stage kept across reposts (test-messenger-conformance.ps1, 2026-10-06).

receipt.receiver.evidence: Run against wezfleet main 1122461 in an isolated root, driven by main's own Stop hook (hooks/wf-mail-deliver.mjs) and no real session (2026-10-09): status read handed-over after the hook's block, seen only once the block's id was in the session's transcript, and expired when the hook gave up after its attempt cap without finding it. Read, not run: the receiving session's own mail read of its own mailbox also sets taken. Open upstream, wezfleet issue 67 S8: a transcript can hold the id from a wake notice alone, so seen proves the id reached the receiver's transcript, not that the body did.

wake.evidence: Run against the fake only: exactly one wake per message, one line, no control characters, none of the body (test-messenger-conformance.ps1, 2026-10-06). Read, not run: wezfleet main 1122461 types its one-line notice carrying only the id, and only into a registry-verified pane whose current occupant is the target (lib/MailPost.ps1, Invoke-WfMailWake). No real wake into a real pane has been measured: the isolated probe of 2026-10-09 had no registry record, so main answered no-registry-record and typed nothing.
